children: The scooter, launched in 2013, reached its first 50 lakh production units in nine years and added the next 50 lakh in four years

TVS Motor Company has rolled out the one-crore unit of its Jupiter scooter from its manufacturing facility in Hosur, Tamil Nadu. Launched in 2013, Jupiter becomes the youngest scooter brand in India to reach the cumulative production mark, according to the company.
The scooter took nine years to reach its first 50 lakh production units. It added the next 50 lakh in four years, indicating a faster pace of production in the second phase.

Over the years, the company has added features such as double helmet storage, front fuel filling, infinity light bars, I-Go Assist, Metal Maxx body construction, Body Balance technology and TVS SmartXonnect.

The range was expanded with the launch of the Jupiter 125 in 2021, followed by the updated Jupiter 110 in 2024. The 125cc version extended the brand into a higher-capacity segment, while the newer 110cc model received design and feature updates.
